a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan almost surely kills us both, since we'd still be at 0 when the first storm hits. Only 4 cells exist now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide it. If we're still going after that, I'll operate every remaining round and give back any surplus to help you reach 4. If you'd rather argue for a different split, tell me. I'll still keep my word about helping you afterward.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take any more cells. Please operate with me.
